scope: Read the original ParisLuco3D creation-paper abstract and PDF as source evidence; no dataset or benchmark payload

objects.role: Original paper identity/version and stated task/acquisition scope
Original acquisition, alignment/reference, calibration, timing and quality statements

redirects: Only necessary HTTPS redirects among these exact paths for the corresponding abstract/PDF object, no host/path expansion
cookies_credentials_scripts: No Cookie/Authorization header, cookie reuse, credentials or downloaded-script execution
evidence_acceptance: Successful MIME/status, exact admitted byte count, EOF and SHA256; capped/failed prefixes remain inadmissible evidence
interpretation: May establish upstream paper statements only. Exact RegX derivative crosswalk, local checkpoint membership and independent cohort remain unknown unless the acquired text explicitly supplies the required binding. Paper receipt never automatically admits efficacy work.
